name: 曹卫球(Mike)
title: 委员
bio:
曹卫球先生现任中国环境科学学会气候投融资专业委员会CIFA委员，同时担任上海青放科技有限公司Shanghai Green Carbon and Green Hydrogen Technology Co., Ltd. 总经理、上海牧溢投资咨询有限公司Shanghai Mu Yi Investment Advisors Ltd.执行董事。社会兼职：北京大学国家发展研究院绿色低碳发展协会专家顾问组专家、中国石墨烯产业技术创新战略联盟会员、天津外国语大学策马ESG产业学院导师等社会职务。他曾任联合国项目事务署高级研究与战略规划官员负责智慧农业和食品安全亚太示范区项目。
曹卫球先生深耕可持续发展与气候应对领域多年，长期致力于该领域的基础理论研究，以及产业与行业发展研究。凭借近20年的科技产业化服务经验，他将理论研究成果有效转化应用，为 ESG 发展与碳中和事业持续贡献力量。
在学术研究层面，曹卫球先生成果斐然。他在全球范围内首创平衡的碳定价模型，并创新提出运用货币政策和金融市场机制应对气候系统性风险等理论。在产业研究领域，其生态文明特区、还原式产业发展、低成本绿氢绿碳产业发展等理论具有开创性意义。
在产业实践方面，曹卫球先生聚焦早期可持续发展与碳移除领域的高科技企业。基于对绿氢产业化痛点和堵点的深入研究，他创立上海青放科技有限公司，旨在推动低成本绿氢绿碳产业化项目落地。低成本绿氢绿碳产业有望从根本上解决甲烷减排、碳移除、范围三脱碳、碳纳米材料绿色低碳转型，以及绿氢制备经济性等一系列关键问题。如需了解更多信息，欢迎关注微信公众号 “曹卫球”。

name: ZHANG Yi
title: Dr.
bio: Dr. Zhang obtained her Bachelor degree in the Department of Environment Science and Engineering, Fudan University, in 2002, before pursuing her graduate study with Nanyang Technological University, Singapore. In School of Civil and Environmental Engineering, she focused her research on the treatment of toxic industrial wastewaters via novel biological processes, i.e. aerobic granular sludge systems. She started working as a project officer in 2006, in the Institute of Environmental Science and Engineering, where she expanded her expertise into areas such as ballast water treatment, bunker fuel and clean energy. After being awarded her Doctoral degree, she joined her alma mater as a lecturer, and later became Associate Professor. Her research interests, though centering on, are not limited to environmental engineering and wastewater treatment. Dr. Zhang believes the solution to mankind’s environmental problems requires interdisciplinary collaboration and holistic mindset. Therefore, her present research involves the interconnection of resource reclamation from waste streams, new materials and renewable energy, as well as social aspects and human values.

name: Paolo Piffaretti
title: CEO
bio:
Paolo Piffaretti is the Co-Founder and CEO of ClimeFi, the first portfolio management company dedicated exclusively to corporate buyers of durable carbon dioxide removal.
Before ClimeFi, Paolo founded two startups and led Algolia's decarbonisation efforts as Head of Net Zero, where he experienced firsthand the structural gap between corporate climate ambition and the quality of CDR supply available to buyers. That experience became the founding thesis of ClimeFi.
Under his leadership, ClimeFi today manages over 700,000 tonnes of durable CDR on behalf of corporate clients, and has pioneered two landmark transactions: the world's first CDR-backed ITMO transaction under Article 6 of the Paris Agreement, structured between Norway and Switzerland, and Europe's first deal certified under the EU Carbon Removal Certification Framework, milestones that reflect ClimeFi's position at the intersection of policy, finance, and carbon removal markets.

bio:
Allan Chou (周立玮) is the founder of Hydrogen Design Center, a nonprofit global incubator advancing hydrogen technology for decarbonization and green energy transition. A prominent advocate for sustainable development, he bridges innovation, education, and climate action, aligning his work with the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and global carbon neutrality efforts. As a thought leader, Chou empowers youth and businesses to drive systemic change, making him a key voice in Asia’s climate and sustainability landscape.

Chou’s contributions span academia, innovation challenges, and clean tech advocacy. At Fudan University, he mentors FMBA students, teaches “Reverse Innovation Path” (emphasizing downstream needs to guide R&D), and leads SDG-focused courses, including co-presenting the “Great SDGs Challenge” at the 2022 QS Asia-Pacific Summit. As Global Advisor to the International Kaleidoscope Challenge (ICC), he moderated decarbonization roundtables and delivered closing remarks championing youth empowerment. Through Hydrogen Design Center, he promotes hydrogen as a critical tool for China’s “dual carbon” goals, while mentoring social innovation projects like the “Shuangti Circular Lunch Box” to reduce plastic waste.

Guided by principles of youth empowerment, independent thinking, and practical application, Chou fosters cross-border collaboration in sustainability. His roles—from Fudan lecturer to honorary ambassador for Island Innovation—reflect a commitment to merging theory with action. While direct participation in Shanghai Climate Week isn’t detailed, his expertise in hydrogen tech and SDG-driven innovation aligns with the event’s mission of “China Action, Asian Voice, World Standards,” positioning him as a vital contributor to climate dialogue and green transition.

name: Simon Learmount
title: Professor
bio:
Simon Learmount is Professor of Corporate Governance at Cambridge Judge Business School and Fellow of Pembroke College, University of Cambridge.
He has served as Director of both the MBA and Executive MBA Programmes at Cambridge, and is recipient of the Pilkington Prize, awarded by the University of Cambridge to honour outstanding teaching across the university.
His research focus is on international corporate governance (notably in the US, UK, Japan and China) with a concentration on digital (including cyber-security and AI) and sustainability (including climate and nature) governance and ethics.
He is Director of the Cambridge Board Director Programme, is a member of the World Economic Forum Global Futures Council on Climate and Nature, is an Ambassador fot Chapter Zero Alliance and advises multiple organisations on digital and cyber governance, sustainability and green transition, risk management and director development.

name: Paul van Brenkelen
title: Director and Co-founder
bio:
Mr. van Brenkelen is a business professional and board member with 30 years of experience in quality assurance, supply chain, sustainability, Risk management and innovation, having worked for various testing, inspection, certification and assurance companies (TIC).  Working with subsidiaries, regulatory bodies and governments across the globe brought him to Asia (Hong Kong) in 2005 and Shanghai since 2018. He is the Director & Co-founder of EQOLOGIC®.
Mr. van Brenkelen worked in various senior leadership positions with SGS, Bureau Veritas, TUV NORD, Intertek and the startup and incubation scene related to ESG aspects.  Innovation, product development, sustainability, change management, and KAM have been the main drivers for various new global businesses managed by him across food-feed agri complexes, consumer products, product/process and system certification, renewables industrial products.
Sustainability and board involvement drive the ESG agenda for firms with differences amongst jurisdictions, especially led by risk management and brand protection questions raised by boards due to increased litigation cases around corporate governance (CG), green house gasses (GHG), diversity/equity/inclusion (DEI) and cybersecurity/artificial intelligence (AI) . An area Mr. van Brenkelen further specialized in and a valuable expansion of his long-term TIC/QA expertise.
Mr. van Brenkelen has been instrumental in developing global supply chain solutions and methodologies for agri-food complexes, Green House gasses, carbon reduction & carbon offsets, governmental departments and corporates. Implementing social and labour related aspects for institutes, brands and retail since 1998. And building supply chain solutions in geopolitical or regulatory demanding environments providing for chain-of-custody/traceability for data and raw materials origins covering up- and downstream nodes as requested by e.g. governing/statutory bodies 
Mr. van Brenkelen holds a BASc in Agricultural Science, MSc in Agronomy, Master of Applied Business Research (MABR), and various post-graduates and designations in corporate governance, ESG and Risk Management and currently pursues a Doctorate in Business Administration (DBA).
